# DEC-book-link-policy: Link policy: replace or strip dead links, report relevance mismatches

- Status: ACTIVE
- Provenance: PROPOSED
- Type: DEC
- Revised: 2026-09-03

## Statement

Link policy: replace or strip dead links, report relevance mismatches

## Payload

```json
{
  "decision": "Dead URLs: find replacement or archived copy, otherwise remove URL and keep the bibliographic entry. Alive but irrelevant links: reported with proposed replacement; ambiguous cases go to the owner as a list. Final link report is part of the handoff.",
  "date": "2026-09-04"
}
```
